results.title: Fix: Unsafe Code Loading from User Input Could Execute Malicious Programs in scrapy/commands/genspider.py
results.extractability_reason: It states as fact that untrusted input reaching import_module allows arbitrary code loading and was fixed, so the required behaviour is that user-supplied values must not cause arbitrary modules to be imported.
results.accepted_requirement: The system shall prevent user-supplied input used to identify a module from causing arbitrary code to be loaded and executed when generating a spider.

iteration_history.candidate: The system shall prevent user-supplied input used to identify a module from causing arbitrary code to be loaded and executed when generating a spider.
